name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: This name will be displayed in the Homebridge log.

email.title: Email
email.description: It is recommended to set up a separate account for Homebridge and share the devices from your main account.

ignoredDevices.title: Ignored Devices
ignoredDevices.description: ThingNames of devices that should not be exposed to HomeKit. Managed via the device list in the plugin settings UI.

autoCleanWhenPowerOff.title: Auto Frost Wash (自動凍結洗淨) On by Default
autoCleanWhenPowerOff.description: Initial state of each device's 自動凍結洗淨 switch in HomeKit. While the switch is on, a frost wash starts once the device has been off for 5 minutes and reports that cleaning is recommended. After the switch has been toggled in the Home app, the switch wins. Host (owner) account only.

showFrostWash.title: Show Frost Wash (凍結洗淨) in Home
showFrostWash.description: Expose the 凍結洗淨通知 sensor and the 凍結洗淨 / 自動凍結洗淨 switches. When off, they are removed from HomeKit and the automatic frost wash does not run. Default for devices without their own setting in Per-device Settings.

showHumiditySensor.title: Show Humidity Sensor in Home
showHumiditySensor.description: Expose the indoor humidity reported by each air conditioner. Default for devices without their own setting in Per-device Settings.

showAirQualitySensor.title: Show Air Quality Sensor in Home
showAirQualitySensor.description: Expose the air quality level and PM2.5 density reported by each air conditioner. Default for devices without their own setting in Per-device Settings.

devices.title: Per-device Settings
devices.description: Overrides of the show options for individual devices, by ThingName. Managed via the device list in the plugin settings UI.

debugMode.title: Debug Mode
debugMode.description: When enabled, debug messages will be written to the log.
